crossRefs.note: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are…
One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.
There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death.…
and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

translations.web: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
translations.bsb: The clods of the valley are sweet to him; everyone follows behind him, and those before him are without number.
translations.kjv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before
translations.asv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, And all men shall draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.
